from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyIncomeRecord(BaseModel):
    """A single company's non-operating income record extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company in the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period (e.g., 2024 Q1)")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The label of the financial line item as written in the document")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the non-operating income")
    currency_unit: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit (e.g., 元)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    income_records: list[CompanyIncomeRecord]
